body:
MAINLINE-063 is complete. Inputs are QUESTIONABLE. Targets are PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor. Simjob simjob-20261020t141536-2e6f2680cba4 exited 0 after 222 s and reproduced 061 at R 20 and R 30, both weathers and both bases.

The float rests on the favorable gamma ramp and Q=0.82 together. At R 30 the joint revert returns 95.7% of the log-spread, 1.55 times the separate log-deltas added. ISA density factor 2.0802, against endpoint 1.0593 and handbook 2.1435. Optimistic 2.1806, against 1.1001 and 2.2480. Alone, gamma is 48.9% and 49.8%, Q is 13.0% and 11.9%, film 2.8%, modulus 0.3%, strength 0.0%. Scarf shear already binds, so the 379.2 MPa lot adds nothing.

From the handbook, gamma and Q stay short of closure at their caps (gamma 1, Q 0.82). Closure in this model is face density divided by 2.1435 (ISA, 863 kg/m³) or 2.2480 (optimistic, 823 kg/m³). Modulus alone closes only in ISA, at 626 GPa, past the 306.9 GPa polycrystal limit. Left favorable, concept still needs density divided by 1.0593 or 1.1001. R 30 TRL 7, +5595 kg and +1457 kg, turns negative if either coefficient returns to the handbook.

The gamma ramp is not admissible. Handbook 0.20 is admissible as the CR-1457 hemisphere value, with that limit. Q=0.82 is the classical cap. Q=0.33 is the 1969 design coefficient, admissible with that limit. Settles: ground-first rank 5 coupon T3 at 6–18 kUSD, and rank 1 gamma shell then T7 at 30–90 kUSD. FE-NEXT's measured article remains the bar. Files pinned. Stopping.
